sentiment: Patience is light deciding to crawl, color deciding to bloom, and a careful machine deciding it would rather not hurry.

stories.title: What if the speed of light was 5 km/h?
stories.summary: A thought experiment that slows light to a walking pace until relativity becomes something you can watch cross a room — proof that wonder often just means giving a familiar thing time to travel.

stories.title: Larger Pacific Striped Octopus
stories.summary: A creature that carries its whole vocabulary on its skin, blooming color ring by ring instead of speaking — a reminder that some messages are meant to be watched, not heard.

stories.title: Growing proof that autonomous cars save lives
stories.summary: Evidence accumulating that a machine which never gets tired or distracted is quietly saving people — the case for care that does not hurry, and does not look away.
